test_title: SSC Selection Post Matric Level Official Paper (Held on: 4 Aug 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

It is always good to eat ________ of different colours.
solution:
The correct answer is** 'Option 2'** i.e.** 'Vegetables'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The sentence **refers to** the idea of consuming foods of different colors, which is primarily associated with fruits and vegetables.
 
• **Each color** in fruits and vegetables is caused by specific nutrients, and hence, eating a diversity of colors can provide a wide range of beneficial nutrients.

Therefore, the **correct sentence** is: *'It is always good to eat** vegetables** of different colours.'*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Wheat, meat, and rice generally do not come in a variety of colors. Therefore, **"vegetables"** is the correct answer.
